schema.description: The day an illness ended, one row in a records file (source records). Closes the illness.episode series its started row opened; values are the row's own text.

date.description: The day the illness ended. Sydney local date, YYYY-MM-DD, as the records row writes it. This is the fact time.

episode.description: The episode key the rows of one illness share, written by hand; it names the illness.episode series this row belongs to. It must match the illness.started row it closes.

id.description: The row id the records file assigns, chosen once and never derived from the content. This is the identity.

note.description: Free text about the end of the illness, as the row writes it.
